scientific_integrity: One exact theorem for all prime powers of characteristic p>n; computational checks over specified prime fields only; novelty is provisional and earlier structural work is credited.
scientific_limitations: The tame restriction p>n is required.
The theorem does not cover general local Artin algebras or small characteristic.
Potential broad right-equivalence results could imply some consequences.
Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Cyclotomic fixed-subalgebra spectra of tame truncated-polynomial automorphisms
